note: Google Translator embeds Google Translate's client-side Website Translator as a Drupal block. All persistent state is the config object google_translator.settings (keys: google_translator_active_languages_display_mode in {SIMPLE,HORIZONTAL,VERTICAL}, google_translator_active_languages array of Google short codes, google_translator_disclaimer_title, google_translator_disclaimer). Config form route google_translator.config at /admin/config/regional/google-translator; permission 'administer google_translator settings'; block plugin id 'google_translator'. Medium cases seed known values into that config for read-back; hard cases mutate config and/or place the block, verified against live config/block entities.

evals.prompt: In the Drupal google_translator module, which configuration object stores the widget settings, and what are the three allowed values of the display-mode setting?
evals.expected_output: Settings live in the google_translator.settings config object. The key google_translator_active_languages_display_mode accepts SIMPLE, HORIZONTAL, or VERTICAL.

evals.prompt: How do I actually show the Google Translator language selector on my Drupal site's pages, and what is the block plugin id?
evals.expected_output: It ships a Block plugin with id 'google_translator' (admin label 'Google Translator'). Place it via Structure > Block layout into a region (or a block.block.* config entity).

evals.prompt: Which permission and which admin route control the Google Translator settings form in Drupal?
evals.expected_output: The permission is 'administer google_translator settings' (core 'administer site configuration' also grants access). The form is route google_translator.config at /admin/config/regional/google-translator.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, inspect the live google_translator configuration and tell me which widget display mode is currently configured for the Google Translator block.
evals.expected_output: google_translator.settings has google_translator_active_languages_display_mode set to VERTICAL (the active languages are fr and de).

evals.prompt: Read the live Google Translator configuration on this site and report the exact disclaimer modal title that is currently set.
evals.expected_output: google_translator.settings key google_translator_disclaimer_title is 'GT Eval Notice Zephyr'.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure the Google Translator module so its widget uses the HORIZONTAL display mode and offers Japanese (langcode ja) among its active languages. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set google_translator.settings google_translator_active_languages_display_mode to HORIZONTAL and include 'ja' in google_translator_active_languages (e.g. via drush cset or the settings form at /admin/config/regional/google-translator).

evals.prompt: I want the little 'Translate this page' language picker from the Google Translator module to actually show up on my Drupal site. Please make it appear somewhere on the page.
evals.expected_output: Place the 'google_translator' block into a visible region of the default theme (Structure > Block layout, or a block.block.* config entity), leaving it enabled.
